translations.web: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
translations.bsb: Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips.
translations.kjv: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
translations.asv: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that give gifts for another god: Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take their names upon my lips.
